entry.dependencies: Python standard library; the page uses inline CSS/JS without network resources
entry.writes: only --out and optional --model-out, created exclusively; refuses existing paths

exit_codes.2: invalid root, existing output, or read failure

model.edge_direction: Every edge runs upstream -> downstream (basis or input -> derived record). Relations stated from the dependent side are reversed and renamed on creation.
model.edge_context: An edge with a cycle field holds only for that cycle version; the page indexes edges for the selected version. Evidence source edges carry the cycle that pairs the evidence map with a ledger.

stage_marks.current: the cycle's recorded stage; status shown from the checker
stage_marks.recorded: a stage reference is present and the checker inspected the stage
stage_marks.recorded_unchecked: a stage reference is present but the checker did not inspect the stage (after the current stage, or after direction_choice while waiting_human)
stage_marks.unconfirmed: the cycle names a selected direction that its discussion decision does not record
stage_marks.gap: a stage reference is missing, outside the root or invalid
stage_marks.rule: Marks never follow stage order; a stage before the current one is not shown as passed without a record.

record_mapping.status_source: check_research_cycle(root, record): overall, status, next_action, findings

edges.findings[].evidence[]: source -> finding with evidence.relation kept: supports, contradicts, qualifies, context (as context_for); any other value becomes neutral cited_by with the stated value. Drawn once per cycle that names both this map and a ledger, with that cycle on the edge; scan order never chooses a ledger.

nodes.decision: decision when status is not pending

branch_states.not_selected: other declared directions after a decision

record_mapping.not_shown: check_research_revision results are not yet integrated

states.null: not recorded yet; not a gap
states.missing | outside_root | invalid: listed as a gap; no edge drawn
states.unresolved ID: listed as a gap; no edge drawn

structure_observations.detail: research-revision-v1 has no cycle_id, study_id or version; the view can group it only by directory.
An evidence map carries preparation_id but no ledger path; source links depend on a cycle naming both.
Discussion versions are linked only through cycle previous_version.
Most records use schema; research-revision-v1 uses schema_version.
Stage exits live in machine/design/research-guidance-cycle.json; the checker does not export them and the page keeps its own labels.
Cycle next_action, checker next_action and evidence-map review_decision.next_action coexist; the view prefers the checker.

validation.automated: tests/research_support/test_study_view.py: version order, checker reuse, edge direction, evidence relations including unknown values, per-cycle ledger pairing in both scan orders, record-based stage marks (pending choice at a later stage, return to an earlier stage, unconfirmed selection), branch states, revision chain, gaps vs null, later-stage needs_work, symlink/dot exclusion, script-close escaping, CLI no-overwrite
validation.manual: Demo page inspected in a browser at desktop and 375 px widths: all tabs, trace highlighting, detail panel; no console errors or horizontal overflow
not_done: Use on a real study directory
Reader study of whether the page explains a research path
